subject: general
question: 'Samvidhan Divas', is celebrated on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26th November.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Every year on** November 26th, **India commemorates the adoption of its Constitution by observing S**amvidhan Divas, or Constitution Day.**
 
• The** inaugural Constitution Day** was observed in 2015 as a memorial to** Bhim Rao Ambedkar, India's first law minister, **who was instrumental in the Constitution's writing.
 
• On October 11, 2015, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi **made the announcement as he laid the cornerstone for the **Statue of Equality in Mumbai.**
